title: 第10章 我勒个邪修啊第11章 规划
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: “所以你们就全喝完了，没给我留点？！”
赵归涯和欧阳叙白两个‘练练’完，一回洞府，就见里面几个正满意的摸着肚子，甚至一直都挺正直的柳清晏还打了个饱嗝。
赵归涯站在洞口，一手里还拎着蔫头耷脑的欧阳叙白，一手捂着心口，看到空空如也的食盒：“你们这群没良心的！
我一大早起来熬的灵米粥啊！
我一口都没喝啊……”
楚安芷心虚地擦了擦嘴角：“那个……确实太好吃了……”
“就是就是，”
封无痕意犹未尽地咂咂嘴，“小未啊，你这手艺跟谁学的？”
赵归涯无奈：“有段时间对做饭很感兴趣。”
说着把欧阳叙白往一旁石凳上一丢，看着欧阳叙白坐稳了，自己也挨着楚安芷坐了下来。
“师尊应该已经给你们说过我的事了吧。”
结果就见自家师叔们和师兄（姐）齐齐看向自家师尊。
而自家师尊一脸尴尬：“那什么，抢粥，忘了。”
赵归涯：……
“咳咳，”
叶知秋清了清嗓子打破尴尬，“小未啊，你和小白这是...？”
赵归涯瞥了眼在一边装死的欧阳叙白，后者立刻一个激灵：“小舅我错了！
我真不是故意的！
当年我是真心想救你，哪知道里面掺杂了那么多传送符啊！”
“传送符？”
柳清漪眨巴着眼，看看欧阳叙白又看看赵归涯，“等等，小白叫小未小舅？小未不是比小白还要小一岁吗？”
“因为辈分啊，”
欧阳叙白哭丧着脸，“我娘是他的堂姐。”
赵归涯看着一脸哭丧的欧阳旭白无奈开口：“还是我来说吧。”
他一脸正色地环顾了一圈，说道：“我叫赵归涯，欲宗色门门主赵惊昼正是家母。”
这句话如同一道惊雷在洞府内炸开。
叶知秋手中的茶盏‘啪嗒’一声掉在地上，封无痕张大了嘴巴，柳家兄妹则同步露出了震惊的表情，其中柳清漪肉眼可见的激动。
封无痕结结巴巴地重复，“那个连剑修都富的流油的欲宗？”
“色门门主？”
柳清漪的声音陡然拔高了八度，“那个两百岁就步入合体期，说出‘众生笑我风情盛，我嗤众生蝼蚁轻。
’的破暝尊君！”
“什么，你妈是破瞑尊君！”
楚安芷一脸震惊。
那可是原身最最最崇拜的人呐！
话音刚落，所有人齐刷刷的看向她。
赵归涯嘴角直抽：“我的好师尊呐，别人震惊很正常，你震惊什么个鬼啊？昨天我不是跟你说过了吗？”
楚安芷转头看向赵归涯：“你只说了你母亲是欲宗的人。”
还有你妈是穿越的。
赵归涯震惊用眼神回应：不是，书中没写吗？
楚安芷也眼神示意：没
content_en:
"So you drank them all and didn't leave any for me?!"
After Zhao Guiya and Ouyang Xubai finished their 'practice', they returned to the cave and saw several people inside rubbing their bellies with satisfaction, and even Liu Qingyan, who had always been upright, even burped.
Zhao Guiya stood at the entrance of the cave, holding Ouyang Xubai with a slumped head in one hand, and covering his heart with the other hand when he saw the empty food box: "You heartless people!
I woke up early in the morning to make rice porridge!
I didn’t even drink a sip…”
Chu Anzhi wiped the corner of her mouth guiltily: "That... is really delicious..."
"That's right,"
Feng Wuhen smacked his lips, "Xiao Wei, who did you learn this skill from?"
Zhao Guiya was helpless: "I have been interested in cooking for a while."
As he spoke, he threw Ouyang Xubai on the stone bench aside. Seeing Ouyang Xubai sit firmly, he also sat down next to Chu Anzhi.
"Master should have told you about me."
As a result, I saw my uncles and brothers (sisters) all looking at my master.
But my master looked embarrassed: "What about grabbing porridge, forget it."
Zhao Guiya:......
"Ahem,"
Ye Zhiqiu cleared his throat to break the awkwardness, "Xiao Wei, what are you and Xiao Bai...?"
Zhao Guiya glanced at Ouyang Xubai, who was pretending to be dead, and the latter immediately became excited: "Brother, I was wrong!
I really didn't mean it!
I really wanted to save you back then, but I didn't know there were so many teleportation talismans mixed in! "
"Teleportation talisman?"
Liu Qingyi blinked, looked at Ouyang Xubai and then at Zhao Guiya, "Wait a minute, Xiaobai calls Xiaowei uncle? Isn't Xiaowei one year younger than Xiaobai?"
"Because of seniority,"
Ouyang Xubai cried sadly, "My mother is his cousin."
Zhao Guiya looked at Ouyang Xubai who was crying and said helplessly: "Let me do the talking."
He looked around with a serious face and said, "My name is Zhao Guiya, and Zhao Jingzhou, the master of the Yu Zongse Sect, is my mother."
These words were like thunder exploding in the cave.
The tea cup in Ye Zhiqiu's hand fell to the ground with a clatter, Feng Wuhen opened his mouth wide, and the Liu brothers and sisters simultaneously showed shocked expressions, among which Liu Qingyi's excitement was visible to the naked eye.
"Yu...Yu Sect?"
Feng Wuhen stuttered and repeated, "That oily Yu Sect who is even rich as a swordsman?"
"Master of the Semen Sect?"
Liu Qingyi's voice suddenly rose an octave higher, "The man who entered the integration stage at the age of two hundred said, 'All living beings laugh at me for being charming, and I laugh at all living beings for being so young.
’ Po Ming Zunjun! "
"What, your mother is Lord Po Meng!"
Chu Anzhi looked shocked.
That is the person I admire the most!
As soon as she finished speaking, everyone looked at her.
Zhao Guiya's mouth twitched: "My good master, it's normal for others to be shocked. Why are you shocked? Didn't I tell you yesterday?"
Chu Anzhi turned to look at Zhao Guiya: "You only said that your mother is from the Yu Sect."
And your mother is a time traveler.
Zhao Guiya was shocked and responded with his eyes: No, isn't it written in the book?
Chu Anzhi also indicated with her eyes: No.
